summary: Maintain A Resource/Work Center Master For Validated Production Equipm
businessObject: Work Center Master Record with Calibration/Qualification tracking

acceptanceCriteria.text: The user can access the "Manage Work Centers" Fiori app.
The system captures the equipment's qualification/calibration expiration date on the work center master.
The system prevents scheduling a process order operation on a work center whose calibration has expired.
The system generates an alert to Maintenance a configurable number of days before a work center's calibration is due to expire.
Equipment taken out of service for maintenance is automatically excluded from capacity planning until requalified.
The batch record references the specific equipment/work center used, including its calibration status at time of use.

HP.description: Create Work Center with valid calibration date and verify capacity planning eligibility
Update existing Work Center with new calibration expiration date
Verify alert generated when calibration expiration is within alert lead-time threshold
Verify batch record captures Work Center ID and calibration status at production confirmation

AP.description: Mark Work Center as "Out of Service" and verify automatic exclusion from capacity planning
Requalify Work Center (update calibration date post-maintenance) and verify re-inclusion in capacity planning
Configure custom alert lead-time (non-default value) and verify alert timing

NEG.description: Attempt to schedule Process Order operation on Work Center with expired calibration
Attempt to schedule Process Order operation on Work Center marked "Out of Service"
Enter past date as calibration expiration date and verify validation error

ERR.description: Missing Equipment Number (when calibration tracking required)

EDGE.description: Calibration expiration date = Today (minimum valid boundary)
Alert lead-time = 0 days (alert on expiration day only)
Calibration expiration date = exactly alert lead-time days from today (boundary trigger)

INT.description: Calibration date in Equipment Master (PM) propagates to Work Center Master (PP)
Process Order scheduling engine queries Work Center calibration status before assignment
Alert notification created in PM Notifications module and routed to Maintenance Planner
Batch record in QM captures Equipment ID and calibration status from Work Center at production confirmation
Background job scans Work Centers and generates alerts based on configurable lead-time
